input_fields.name: failed_call
input_fields.description: One failing call expression, source location, error, and unchanged surrounding context.

input_fields.name: target_version_signature
input_fields.description: Target API owner, namespace/member, argument names/types, and authoritative reference.

result_fields.name: corrected_call_snippet
result_fields.description: One copyable replacement call, not a workflow.

result_fields.name: needs_manual_review
result_fields.description: True when target signature or one-call boundary is unproven.

procedure: Parse owner, member, arguments, and error location; preserve unrelated arguments and strategy.
Compare with target_version_signature and replace only the mismatched binding.
Emit one corrected_call_snippet plus changed_binding and source references.
If signature cannot be verified, emit needs_manual_review=true and an empty snippet.
rejection_rules: Reject multiple calls, missing target signature, or changes that alter geometry strategy.
Reject arbitrary namespace renaming from another version.
Do not claim corrected call executed.
